filter: CLIP whole-photo person probability >= 0.15 (2,454 of 9,445 trusted photos)
auto_rule: OWLv2 person >= 0.10 AND expected item >= 0.10 AND item box < 70% of the Phase 1b crop (phase2b_image_encoders.auto_rule)
recrop: auto_rule AND accepted in person_crops_reviewed.json (human check by eye)
owl_person: a photo of a human face
a photo of a human hand
person_prompts: a fashion model wearing the item
legs and feet of a person
product_prompts: a product photo on a white background
a packshot of a fashion accessory
provenance_note: Written after the run from its saved results (the experiment and the module share prompts and thresholds); the prose fields `auto_rule` / `recrop` replace the numeric keys `cmd_persons` writes (`person_min`, `item_min`, `max_share_of_crop`).
